page.layout: One column of running text, with the printed page number and running head at the top. The catchword sits at the right below the last line.

main_text.l: Librum de Baptismo ex omni parte ab-
solutum, de quo tamen in Indice mox
EXTAT & alius Liber à Morino edi-
tus, quem tamen antea cum aliis ejusdem
sus, omniaqve illius exemplaria, ne in pu-
tatis suae morbis, illa omnia, quae in ea
reprehendens: at quia notat in hoc
ne Societatis, quae aetate nostra non ita
isto opere contendit omnia pro arbitra-
tu suo regere, spretis Ecclesiae legibus,

page.notes: A small dot-like mark stands in the text after "nolui" and before "quia"; it is a printing mark, not a note. Several stains and specks in the margins are not printed text. The catchword "verbis" is printed alone at the lower right and is therefore given as catchword, not in the text.
